title: Findings
hint: Things Intelligence noticed in your business that are worth a look. Each is a question to answer, not a verdict.
atStakeMixed: Shown in the first company's currency
noMatchHint: Change or clear the filters to see more.
empty: Nothing to look at right now
emptyHint: When Intelligence notices something unusual in your sales, stock, payments or books, it appears here with what to do about it.
peopleUnavailable: The list of people could not be loaded: {{message}}
noEvents: Nothing has happened to this finding yet.

dialogHint.acknowledge: Let the team know someone is looking at it. A note is optional.
dialogHint.explain: Say what happened. Your answer is kept with your name, which protects honest staff as well as the business.
dialogHint.resolve: The problem has been dealt with. A note about what was done is helpful.
dialogHint.dismiss: Close this as not a problem. The same thing will not be raised again. A reason is required.
dialogHint.assign: The person will see this finding in their list and can explain it. Leave empty to remove the assignment.
dialogHint.ask: The person is asked to explain what happened and is told by the business's alert channel, if one is on.

done.ask: Asked. They will see it in their findings.

askPersonHint: Only people who can answer findings for this branch can be asked.
assignPersonHint: Only people who can answer findings for this branch can be assigned.
askNeedsLevel: Asking people to explain is switched off for this business. Raise "What Intelligence may do" to level 2 in the settings.
evidenceHint: The figures and records behind this finding.

runHint: Checks also run by themselves every few hours. Run them now after changing a limit or entering a lot of data.

ai.askHint: Ask about sales, stock, customers, suppliers or the books in plain words. Answers are written by AI from your own records, limited to what you may see.

proposal.cardHint: Intelligence prepared these. Nothing happens until a person approves it.
proposal.none: Intelligence has not suggested anything for this finding.
proposal.cannotDecide: Only people with the permission “{{permission}}” can decide on this. Ask the owner if you need it.
proposal.changeable: You can change these before it is done
proposal.approveNote: It is done at once, in your name, and recorded.
proposal.failedGeneric: It could not be done. Try again, or turn the suggestion down.
proposal.reasonHint: Kept with the finding, so others know why nothing was done.

actionsPage.title: Suggested actions
actionsPage.hint: Things Intelligence has prepared for you to approve, and what was decided before.
actionsPage.nothingWaitingHint: When Intelligence prepares an action you can approve, such as a purchase request or a payment reminder, it appears here. Suggestions need the action level set to 3 in Settings.
actionsPage.noHistoryHint: Approved, turned-down and expired suggestions are listed here.

settings.levelHint: Choose how far Intelligence goes when it finds something. You can change this at any time.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can switch this on.
settings.never: Ziira never moves money. Nothing that involves money, prices, credit or stock is done without a person approving it, and every action is recorded.

1.name: Report only
1.does: Intelligence finds problems and tells you. It does nothing else.

2.name: Ask people
2.does: A manager can also ask a named person to explain a finding.
2.raise: Managers will be able to ask a named person to explain a finding.

3.name: Prepare actions
3.does: Intelligence also prepares suggested actions, such as a draft purchase request, a new selling price, a payment reminder or a lower credit limit. A person approves each one, and it is then done at once in that person's name.
3.raise: Intelligence will prepare suggested actions. Each one is done only when a person approves it, in that person's name. Only an Owner can allow this.

4.name: Routine actions by itself
4.does: On top of level 3, routine actions that move no money, such as payment reminders and nudges to approvers, can run by themselves under rules you set, with a daily limit.
4.raise: Intelligence will be allowed to do routine actions that move no money by itself, but only under rules you write, with a daily limit. Without rules it does nothing by itself. Only an Owner can allow this.

settings.lowerWithdraw: Suggestions waiting for approval will be withdrawn and no new ones will be prepared. Automatic rules will stop working. Actions already done stay recorded.
settings.lowerRules: Automatic rules will stop working. Suggestions still wait for a person to approve them.
settings.lowerPlain: Intelligence will do less from now on. Nothing already done is undone.

rules.title: Automatic actions
rules.hint: Only routine actions that move no money, such as payment reminders and nudges to approvers, can run by themselves. Each rule says when, and how many times a day. Prices, credit, stock and money always wait for a person.
rules.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can make, change or switch on these rules. You can pause a rule or switch it off at any time.
rules.belowLevel: These rules do nothing until the level is set to 4.
rules.noneHint: Without a rule, Intelligence never acts by itself.
rules.limitUsed: Up to {{cap}} a day · used {{count}} times
rules.switchOffAsk: “{{action}}” will no longer run by itself. You can switch it on again later.
rules.neverAutomatic: Actions that never run by themselves
rules.conditions: When it may run by itself
rules.conditionsHint: Leave a box empty for no limit.
rules.dailyLimitHint: Once the limit is reached, the rest wait for a person.

log.title: What was done
log.hint: Every action taken from a suggestion, by a person or by Intelligence under a rule.
log.noneHint: Actions appear here as soon as they are done.
